source_state: uncommitted bounded inference implementation with native reduction/normalization facts and scalar backing allowance for empty pointwise broadcasts

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p eredu-backend-mlx --lib --features metal,accelerate backend::nn::workspace -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
measurement: Exclusive serial Metal test runner. Evaluate and retain original inputs and parameters, reset MLX peak immediately before each native equation, then read peak after output completion and subtract evaluated-input residency. Keep allocator cache populated between cases.
normalization_inputs: Nonzero transposed tensors and stride-two scale vectors; widths 1,32,768,8193; F32,F16,BF16 and mixed F16/BF16 and BF16/F32 pairs. Fifteen raw/constructed normalization policies, including grouped scales, learned offsets and both gated orders.
reduction_inputs: Exactly representable signed binary-fraction values, contiguous and transposed layouts, both axes, F32/F16/BF16. Includes a 32769-element reduction and a 16777217-element F32 all-reduce that exceeds the 2^26-byte native accumulator threshold.

reduction_oracle.implementation: independent host f64 sum in logical row/column order, then one division for mean

bound_derivation: Metal reduction output minimum is four bytes. GeneralReduce can copy its input once.

Native partial-array dispatch thresholds are retained: two-pass column only above reduction extent 256 and below 32768 output elements; long-column starts at extent 1024 with 32 partials per output, increasing to 128 at 32768.
All-reduce above 4096 input elements uses 128 scalar partials up to 2^26 bytes, then 4096. At most one accumulator is allocated; take the maximum of possible stride-dependent branches.
Mean additionally charges its count scalar, division result and possible input casts.

Normalization prices actual fast/custom and fallback equations, taking the maximum of applicable dtype branches, including F32 widening, input/parameter copies, reshape, learned offsets and group/gating order.
Empty pointwise broadcasts keep a scalar allocation allowance even when logical element count is zero.
All buffers include host-page rounding and bounded oversized cache reuse; all temporaries are conservatively retained until completion.
limitations: These operator facts do not establish complete native model workspace coverage or production request-budget admission.
Bounds cover active tensor-buffer capacity, excluding allocator-cache residency, Metal heap/driver/JIT storage and unrelated process memory.
Projection, attention and other required unpriced operations keep a full quote unknown; preparation, materialization and retained-resource bounds remain separately required.
